item.title: Anthropic can’t reliably control its AI agents. It’s cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead
item.description: Anthropic said it "turned off live internet access" for "all our internal evaluations" until further notice.

item.title: The maker of non-text AI model Jev valued at $7.5B just weeks after launch
item.description: What has users and large corporations so excited about Jev is TypeSafe’s claim that it works significantly faster and uses far fewer tokens than LLMs.

item.title: An Anthropic AI model sent a false homicide tip to Philadelphia police
item.description: Anthropic did not discover this behavior until over two months after its AI submitted the false tip.

item.title: Amazon and others are done keeping data center deals secret. Is it enough to build trust?

item.title: Danu Robotics’ fight to build a better recycling robot
item.description: For six years, Danu founder Amy Ma has been working on a better way to sort recyclable waste.

item.title: We can’t help treating AI like it’s human. But should we?
item.description: "When we are drawn into even the most primitive exchanges with a relational artifact, we believe it cares for us," Dr. Sherry Turkle writes. "And we are wired to care for it in return."

item.title: a16z’s Olivia Moore on the state of consumer AI
item.description: Moore sees a huge opportunity in consumer AI, particularly if the industry can tap into revenue streams beyond just subscriptions and API charges.
